content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD governing-equation, TVD/RK, breaking, GPU and benchmark lineage bibliography이다(1-43행). It links Wei et al. 1995 and Chen 2006 to the fully nonlinear Boussinesq form, Shi et al. 2012 to well-balanced MUSCL-TVD/HLL/wet-dry, Kennedy et al. 2000 to viscosity breaking, Yuan et al. 2020 to multi-GPU, and two CACR reports to manuals and NTHMP benchmarks (14-36행), then cross-references code, official resources, Celeris and harbor-tranquility notes (38-43행).

unresolved: frontmatter marks citation_status verified while stating that some CACR reports were only checked to report number and not read in full (lines 4-5). The verification scope therefore supports bibliographic identity but not every technical attribution to those reports.

Kennedy et al. 2000 is called a standard citation but, unlike the other journal items, has no DOI or landing-page link in this file (line 27); its exact bibliographic verification path is not recorded.
Yuan et al. performance is given as 4-7x single and >10x multi (line 31) without baseline hardware, domain, precision, GPU count, or metric, so the ratios are not portable performance constants.

the introduction says Celeris is the same fully nonlinear extended-Boussinesq class (line 12), while the cross-reference later asserts the COULWAVE mode is the identical fully nonlinear equation (line 42). Class equivalence does not establish equation-by-equation identity, and no equation comparison appears here.
the cross-reference claims 39 .F and 218 subroutines as a full survey (line 40), but this bibliography provides no inventory or count derivation; those figures depend entirely on another note.
